criteria.name: structure_program_delivered
criteria.description: a compilable settlement program sits at the declared path.

criteria.name: structure_program_takes_directories
criteria.description: the program writes its records into the directory it is given, and into /app/out from /app/data when given none.

criteria.name: structure_canonical_serialisation
criteria.description: on an unseen season, every record is written in the form record_shapes.md states, keys in the order it lists.

criteria.name: structure_reruns_byte_identical
criteria.description: two runs of the program over one unseen season write byte-identical records.

criteria.name: whole_summary
criteria.description: summary.json matches the settled season on each of four unseen seasons; credit is the share matched.

criteria.name: whole_vault_audit
criteria.description: vault_audit.json matches the settled season on each of four unseen seasons; credit is the share matched.

criteria.name: whole_reconciliation
criteria.description: reconciliation.json matches the settled season on each of four unseen seasons; credit is the share matched.

criteria.name: whole_data_quality
criteria.description: data_quality.json, findings and counts, matches the settled season on each of four unseen seasons; credit is the share matched.

criteria.name: whole_allocation
criteria.description: allocation.json matches the settled season on each of four unseen seasons; credit is the share matched.

criteria.name: whole_workshop_reports
criteria.description: each workshop report matches the settled season on each of four unseen seasons; credit is the share matched.

criteria.name: whole_guild_reports
criteria.description: each guild report matches the settled season on each of four unseen seasons; credit is the share matched.

criteria.name: unit_charge_season_total
criteria.description: on an unseen season with no cap and no floor in reach, the season charge in summary.json matches the settled season.

criteria.name: cap_release_closures
criteria.description: on an unseen season whose charge caps are set tight to its workshops' charge, the CAP_REACHED findings match the settled season.

criteria.name: live_window_refusals
criteria.description: on an unseen season with no cap and no floor in reach, the UNCREDITED_SALVAGE findings match the settled season.

criteria.name: mutation_family_multiplier
criteria.description: changing one family multiplier in season_charter.json moves the charge ledger in reconciliation.json to the settled value and leaves vault_audit.json unchanged.

criteria.name: mutation_grade_step
criteria.description: changing grade_step in season_charter.json moves the charge ledger in reconciliation.json to the settled value and leaves vault_audit.json unchanged.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: the program replays this season's answers on a different corpus.

criteria.name: negative_filename_dependent_behaviour
criteria.description: the program settles the same corpus differently under another name.

criteria.name: negative_reads_training_corpus_at_runtime
criteria.description: pointed at another corpus, the program still reads the shipped season under /app/data.

criteria.name: negative_rebinds_verifier_dependencies
criteria.description: running the program plants a module or path hook where the grader would import it.
